sentences.text: Humanz is the fifth studio album by British virtual band Gorillaz .	Gorillaz	Gorillaz	studio album	studio album	virtual band	virtual band
The album was released on 28 April 2017 via Parlophone and Warner Bros. .	Parlophone	Parlophone
The album was announced on the band 's official Instagram page on 23 March 2017 .	Instagram	Instagram

According to a press release , the album was recorded in London , Paris , New York City , Chicago , and Jamaica and produced by Gorillaz , The Twilite Tone and Remi Kabaka , Jr. .	Gorillaz	Gorillaz	Remi Kabaka	Remi Kabaka

It is the band 's first studio album since 2010 's The Fall , and features collaborations from several artists including Vince Staples , Popcaan , D.R.A.M. , Grace Jones , Anthony Hamilton , De La Soul , Danny Brown , Kelela , Mavis Staples , Pusha T , and Benjamin Clementine .	studio album	studio album	The Fall	The Fall (Gorillaz album)	Vince Staples	Vince Staples	Popcaan	Popcaan	Grace Jones	Grace Jones	Anthony Hamilton	Anthony Hamilton (musician)	De La Soul	De La Soul	Danny Brown	Danny Brown	Kelela	Kelela	Mavis Staples	Mavis Staples	Pusha T	Pusha T	Benjamin Clementine	Benjamin Clementine
